name: north_sabah_diapir_thrust_miiec
title: Discriminator set: NW Sabah diapir vs thrust-cored anticline vs MIEC feeder
citation: Morley et al. 2023 (Geosphere v19 no.1) §6 + Figs 5–22; van der Baan & Fomel 2009
description: Three-way discriminator set for NW Sabah high-amplitude packages: mobile-shale diapir (A) vs thrust-cored anticline (B) vs mud-volcano / MIEC feeder (C). Each hypothesis lists REQUIRED OBSERVATIONS (if present, hypothesis stays alive), FALSIFIERS (if present, hypothesis is rejected), and BEST TEST (cheapest discriminating probe). Drives geox_seismic_alternative_interpret.v1.

hypotheses.summary: Highs are mobile-shale diapirs; mini-basins are withdrawal synclines downbuilt into underlying mobile shale.
required_observations: Velocity low under each high (≥5% drop vs flanks, Morley Fig 22)
Continuous reflectors across apparent sags between highs (no real separation)
Crestal graben / extensional fault swarm above single-rising diapir
DRU remains as a single unfolded surface
falsifiers: Velocity is NORMAL under highs (no V low)
Continuous reflectors do NOT cross sags between highs
hypotheses.best_test: Interval velocity cube pull-up/down check at each high; expect DOWN (push-down) for shale diapir.

hypotheses.summary: Highs are thrust-cored anticlines; mini-basins are piggyback synclines on a weak detachment.
required_observations: Reflectors offset across apparent highs (not piercing, but folded-over)
Velocity is NORMAL under highs (no V low)
Thrust faults visible on flanks of highs
hypotheses.best_test: DRU continuity check across each high; expect OFFSET across thrust.

hypotheses.summary: Highs are mud-volcano edifices on narrow feeders; mobile shale below is thinner; canopy at UIU level.
required_observations: Transparent cores with bright zig-zag margins at UIU/IVC level
Vertical feeder pipes extending from below (chaos column)
Onlap of IVC reflectors onto edifice flanks
Gas chimneys above edifices (amplitude attenuation, low frequency)
falsifiers: Gas chimneys absent AND onlap absent
hypotheses.best_test: Vertical coherence-disruption column test above each high.

notes: Discriminator resource — drives multi-hypothesis interpretation. Per the topo_x_strat EUREKA, the unit of interpretation is the body's relationship to its neighbors, NOT the body alone. Each hypothesis requires ≥3 hypotheses to be generated; no auto-verdict; humans (or hermes witness) must seal.
